description.narrative: Objectives for Afghanistan: The United States Agency for International Development (USAID) Engineering Support Program (ESP) provides architectural, engineering and construction management services for infrastructure projects related to energy, transportation, drinking water, sanitation, health, education, and agriculture. ESP also trains Afghan government staff and technicians working for the national power utility, Da Afghanistan Breshna Sherkat (DABS), local contractor personnel, and university students on industry best practices and internationally accepted engineering principles and standards.
